title: My Street
text:
I live on a quiet street. There are many trees and small houses. My neighbor is a kind old man. His name is Mr. Brown.

There is a shop on the corner. It sells fruit and milk. I buy apples there every Saturday. The shop owner is always friendly.

questions.text: What does the shop on the corner sell?
How does the writer probably feel about the street?
Why does the writer probably like the shop?

vocabulary.definition: kind and pleasant to other people
round fruits that are red, green or yellow
the place where two streets or walls meet

paragraph_translations: Я живу на тихій вулиці. Тут багато дерев і невеликих будинків. Мій сусід — добрий старий чоловік. Його звуть містер Браун.
На розі є магазин. Він продає фрукти і молоко. Я купую там яблука щосуботи. Власниця магазину завжди привітна.
